tweet_text: did a quick and interesting test of something with Fable in a raw context: can they 3d model by placing each individual vertex, in the way they had to before the Utah teapot? turns out yes! this may look unimpressive if you think about it in terms of primitives... but there are absolutely no primitives in this model, each vertex coordinate was placed manually by fable and then triangles were added between them
